_note: Curated, reviewed regexes referenced from concerns.json by pattern_ref, so config authors never write raw regex. Shapes are STARTING GUESSES until real emails confirm them (pipeline SP-1.1-07/38). Where several fields share one pattern - DOS, DOI and DOB all use us_date - the field MUST set require_label:true, or a bare match cannot be attributed to any of them.

us_date.description: US date. Accepts / . and - as separators, two- or four-digit years, ISO, and spelled months.

currency_amount.description: US dollar amount, optional $ and thousands separators. A bare integer only counts as money when a $ immediately precedes it, so '42 miles' is not an amount. The comma/decimal forms are listed first so they win over the bare-integer branch - an earlier version put '$\s?\d+' inside the group, which let a leftmost match starting on the preceding space capture just '$1' out of '$1,250.00'. See pipeline SP-1.1-39.

claim_id.description: Carrier claim id. Optional 1-4 letter prefix, 6-14 digits, and an optional -N suffix (5513778-1).

patient_account.description: Patient account / reference number. Alphanumeric, 5-20 chars, and must contain at least one digit so plain words cannot match.

provider_tin.description: Provider Tax ID (federal EIN): 9 digits, commonly written NN-NNNNNNN. The hyphenated form is listed first so it is preferred over a bare 9-digit run.

npi_number.description: National Provider Identifier: exactly 10 digits. Overlaps claim_id and patient_account - always require a label.

invoice_number.description: Invoice or bill number, optionally prefixed.
